name: ReportWitnessedCrime
description: Add a bounty for a crime a witness in this conversation saw the player commit.
note: Needs Mantella Living World - World and Advanced Actions on in Mantella. Guards only. A guard adds a bounty only when another NPC (not one of your followers) is present as a witness, once per crime per talk and at most the vanilla bounty per crime per hold each day. This is a separate action from Mantella's own ReportCrime, which you can keep off.
prompt: If you are a guard, steward or Jarl and someone here tells you they saw the player commit a crime, begin your response with '{key}:'
